service.name: Spanish guitarist
service.serviceType: Solo Spanish guitarist for wedding ceremonies, cocktail hours, dinner parties and corporate dinners
service.description: One Spanish guitarist on nylon strings: Malaguena, rumbas, farrucas and familiar songs played flamenco-style, for wedding ceremonies, cocktail hours, dinner parties, milestone birthdays and corporate dinners across Denver, the Front Range and the Colorado mountain corridor.

faqs.q: What does a Spanish guitarist play?
faqs.a: The pieces people mean when they say Spanish guitar: a Malaguena, rumbas, a farruca, tangos, Entre dos Aguas, plus familiar songs played on nylon strings in the same hand, which is how Can't Help Falling in Love ends up in a processional. It's instrumental, it runs at 65 to 72 dBA at the nearest table, and the set is built with you before the night.

faqs.q: Is a Spanish guitarist the same as flamenco?
faqs.a: It's the solo version of it. Flamenco is a form, played here by Dirty Flamenco as a trio of guitar, bass and cajon with a set piece in the evening. A Spanish guitarist is one musician on nylon strings doing the quieter job: a ceremony, a cocktail hour, a dinner.

faqs.q: Who plays a Spanish guitar booking?
faqs.a: A working Spanish guitarist from the roster, named to you at contract. The booking is booked by its spec: the instrument, the repertoire and the volume above. The named trio, Dirty Flamenco, is the booking to ask for when you want that particular group.

faqs.q: Can a Spanish guitarist play a wedding ceremony outdoors?
faqs.a: Yes, and it's the booking this instrument fits best. Nylon strings carry a prelude and a processional in most indoor spaces without amplification, and outdoors a small system on the same stand carries the guitar and an announcement microphone for the officiant. The site needs to be covered, level and dry with power run to it, and we agree a move-indoors plan with you ahead of time.

faqs.q: How much space does one Spanish guitarist need?
faqs.a: A 6 by 4 foot corner, one dedicated 20-amp circuit when the system is used, a 45-minute load-in and a 30-minute strike. A courtyard, the end of a long table, the landing of a staircase: a guitarist can play in places a band can't.

faqs.q: Can we book a Spanish guitarist for an hour?
faqs.a: Yes. A ceremony, a cocktail hour, a proposal, the toast at a birthday dinner: an hour is a real booking, with one musician, no stage and the same contract as a full night. Send us the date and what the hour is for.
